1. **`formatBytes(n)`** in `src/util.js` — converts bytes to human-readable format (B, KB, MB, GB) with one decimal place
2. **`slugify(title)`** in `src/text.js` — lowercases, trims, replaces spaces with dashes, and strips non-alphanumeric characters except dashes
3. **`fetchUsers(baseUrl)`** in `src/api.js` — fetches from `${baseUrl}/api/users`, parses the JSON array, logs the user count using the logger (not console.log), and returns the array

All functions are exported from their modules.
